purpose: Teach: ライム/アパレル/ハト/アンティーク/鮎/鮭/トンボ/占い師

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんとライムのジュース作りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's make some lime juice together, shall we?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone with a gentle lift at the end. Slow pace—no rush. The voice of someone offering a small, safe ritual. Soft attack on his name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママがアパレルでお買物してたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw Mama shopping at the apparel store today!
lines.style: Quick, bright opening. Eager to share but not breathless—a child offering information as a gift. Eyes bright. Small pause before 'apparel' like he's proud of the word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、公園にハトがたくさん来てるわね
lines.en: Sho, there are so many pigeons in the park these days, aren't there?
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy quality. Speaking as if to herself but including him. Gentle observation, not a question that needs answering. Slight pause before 'pigeons'—noticing them fresh.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんがアンティークの時計を見せてくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandma showed me her antique clock today!
lines.style: Enthusiastic but controlled—not loud, but genuinely animated. Pride in the memory. Clean syllables on 'antique.' Leans toward her slightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんと川で鮎を釣りに行きたいわね
lines.en: Sho, I wonder if Grandpa would take you fishing for ayu down at the river sometime.
lines.style: Wistful, gentle tone. Speaking as if imagining it together. Slow pace. The 'I wonder' carries real affection, not dismissal. Trailing off slightly—inviting him into the possibility.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの鮭おにぎり大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandpa's salmon onigiri!
lines.style: Pure, unguarded affection. Warm and immediate. Quick tempo on the affection. The 'really' gets soft emphasis—not contradicting, just earnest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、公園でトンボを見つけられるかな
lines.en: Sho, do you think we could find a dragonfly at the park?
lines.style: Curious, gently wondering. Opens softly. Slight tilt upward at the question—genuinely curious about his answer, not just making conversation. Inviting him to imagine with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祭りで占い師さんに見てもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got my fortune told by a fortune teller at the festival!
lines.style: Bright, chatty, almost tumbling out. A child bursting to share something magical and a little secret-feeling. Quick pace. Breathless on 'fortune teller'—it was exciting.
